key_decisions.before: Paul replied, “Brothers, I did not know he was the high priest. For it is written, ‘You shall not speak evil about a ruler of your people.’”
key_decisions.after: Paul said, “Brothers, I did not know he was the high priest, for it is written: ‘You must not speak evil of a ruler of your people.’”

key_decisions.before: For the Sadducees say there is no resurrection, angel, or spirit, while the Pharisees affirm them.
key_decisions.after: For the Sadducees say there is no resurrection, angel, or spirit, while the Pharisees affirm them all.
